notes.range: Best within 8 m: full damage, 1 body blast. Down to 25 % (4 blasts) by 28 m; reaches 40 m. Body shots count every pellet on the body (hitscan pellets: by distance).
notes.model: The owner's own Vietnam Tactical Breaching Shotgun (Meshy, owned, 2026-11-27; content/guns.json), sharper copies in your own hands at Medium and High; it replaced the 3DModelsCC0 pump shotgun; its under-barrel launcher is only looks. The kit shotgun is the fallback.
notes.design: Benchmark shotgun: makes you close in. Ten pellets in a fixed 75 mrad pattern: all of them on a body out to about 5 m (one shot kills), a few at 15 m, a scratch at 25 m (pattern and steep falloff).
notes.reload: Shell by shell: each one loaded can be fired straight away.
